The '''Deflarian bunker''' was a bunker on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], used by the criminal organization known as the [[Deflarians]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I do not know where I am. I was at another camp after they hijacked my ship. Then they moved me here. They have me shackled so I cannot escape.|Captain Donovan, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WHtD" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Deflarians hijacked a ship piloted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Donovan (captain)|Donovan]] of the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] and stole its cargo of weapons. They then crashed a ship of the same model than Donovan's to cover the theft of the cargo. Donovan himself was captured and imprisoned in the Deflarian bunker.<ref name="SWG:DC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Deflarian Cleanup|Corellia}}</ref> CorSec [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Cora (Human)|Cora]] hired a spacer to investigate the situation. The spacer managed to find the location of the bunker, infiltrated the building and found the imprisoned Captain Donovan. The spacer therefore killed [[Vinros]], several Deflarian henchmen and a Deflarian underboss to liberate Donovan.<ref name="SWG:WHtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deflarian bunker appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WHtD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Deflarian bunker was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
